title: ChatHealthy DBVersions
description: Source of truth for the active runtime data-collection paths per env per deployment target. One document per managed env. The ChangeDBVersion runbook reads this collection and pushes each target's collection map to the matching runtime so the in-memory state reconciles to the doc. The targets[] list also serves as the runtime deploy registry for this env. Per EPIC-010-F-101-S-005 (Data version management).

env.description: Environment this document configures. Unique across documents in the collection - enforced by a Mongo unique index.

targets.description: One entry per runtime that consumes versioned data from the front-end cluster. This list is the env's runtime deploy registry.

deployment_target.description: Foreign key into deployment_architecture.json: MUST exactly match an existing target_id value defined in the ChatHealthy Deployment Architecture (source of truth: https://dev.chathealthy.ai/schemas/ChatHealthyDeploymentArchitectureSchema.json, field target_id). This binds each DBVersions entry to the canonical deploy target so the ChangeDBVersion runbook can resolve the runtime's network address, env binding, and auth surface from the deploy registry rather than restating them here. Example: target_hf_space_findcare_backend.

collections.description: One entry per logical collection slot the runtime consumes. A versioned collection states its base and its version and the runtime composes the physical name; an unversioned collection states its path directly. An entry is one or the other, never both.

collection_environment_name.description: Identifier the runtime uses for this collection slot. Example: PROVIDER_COLLECTION.

collection_base.description: Fully-qualified DB.collection path WITHOUT a version suffix, for a versioned collection. The runtime composes the physical name as <collection_base>_v_<version>, so the name is never written down and cannot be spelled two ways. This replaced a written runtime_collection_name: the collection had been recorded as both provider_v03 and Provider_v_4, two spellings of one idea, and only the second follows the convention. Example: PublicHealthData.Provider.

version.description: Generation of the versioned collection named by collection_base. Composed into the physical name as _v_<version>. Example: 4, giving PublicHealthData.Provider_v_4.

runtime_collection_name.description: Fully-qualified DB.collection path, for a collection that is NOT versioned and never will be. Example: Users.sessions. A versioned collection MUST use collection_base + version instead: writing its name here is what allowed the convention to be broken by a record.
